_meta.datasheet: Hirose CX90B-16P drawing EDC3-632698 (CX90B-16P_2d.pdf) + product specification CL 6246-0003-2 (cx16p1.pdf, CX90B-16P1 — same contact system)
_meta.datasheet_section: p.1 ratings (current, voltage, operating condition); pin map = USB Type-C 2.0 receptacle (USB-IF Type-C spec, 16-contact) as in the vendor symbol
_meta.package: USB-C 2.0 receptacle, horizontal top-mount: 16 SMD contacts at 0.40 pitch, SH5/SH6 SMD shell pads, SH1-SH4 TH shell slots, MID1/MID2 holes
_meta.notes: USB2-only (no SuperSpeed pins). Rated 48 V AC/DC; 1.25 A per power pin (A1/A4/A9/A12/B1/B4/B5/B9/B12 per the spec's list), 0.25 A other pins. [height] drawing EDC3-632698: body 3.17 ±0.10 mm above the PCB. [temp] spec p.1 OPERATING CONDITION −40…+105 °C (incl. temperature rise).
